scientific_question: Does the already frozen compact w16d2 observation-only dual proposal preserve the unchanged field, gradient, and observation compatibility envelope on one additional independently acquired public PoolFire trajectory while reducing the strict CGLS path from 4A+4A^T to 2A+2A^T per frame?

selection.selection_rule: Use the first trajectory currently absent from the bounded project-managed data and pair roots after the first two entries in the acquisition order frozen by poolfire_c_fit_coverage_expansion_v4.json; this does not prove filesystem-wide historical nonaccess.

arms.path: G_theta(y) -> exact A^T -> observable alpha in [0,2] -> unchanged strict CGLS K1
zero initialization -> unchanged strict CGLS K4

decision_order: both arms exactly match the frozen per-frame A/A^T ledgers
candidate passes the unchanged field, gradient, and observation compatibility envelope
joint and per-metric harm fractions are each at most 0.05 and severe-harm count is zero
only after all preceding gates pass may a separate frozen fresh-process wall and peak-RSS experiment run

failure_actions.compatibility_or_harm_failure: record one independent public development negative; do not retune on this trajectory and do not open untouched tests
failure_actions.stage_1_pass: retain an accuracy-and-call result only; separately preregister resource measurement before claiming acceleration
